name: decline
description: Use instead of answering when the help-center passages don't answer the question ("not_covered"), or the question isn't about {company}'s product ("off_topic"). Call it before writing any text.

name: ask_clarifying_question
description: Use when the question could mean two or three different things that the passages cover differently. Give 2 or 3 options, each a short phrase from the passages, such as "Your password". Call it before writing any text.

name: report_gap
description: Use after answering the part of a question the passages cover, to name what the help center doesn't say. Write a phrase that completes "The help center doesn't say …", such as "whether deleted messages are included".

name: small_talk
description: Use when the message is only a greeting, a thank-you or a goodbye, with no question in it.
